responsibility: Implements -Wformat checking for C-family front ends. It decodes format-related attributes, classifies supported format dialects (printf/scanf, GCC diagnostic formats, Objective-C and target-specific formats), parses format strings, checks argument counts and types against conversion specifications, emits rich location-aware diagnostics and fix-it hints, and consults target and Objective-C hooks when string-object formats are involved.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of format-string analysis and diagnostics: it performs attribute decoding, format parsing, type checking, warning emission, and selftests, while c-format.h supplies the static enums, structs, and table-building macros that describe format kinds and argument metadata.
